summary: Preserve replicated work reasons during local quiet lease renewals

replay.detail: No full replay or source rewrite; quiet renewal retains the last durable reason. Existing corrupted projections remain an explicit forward-repair/integration concern.

schema.detail: No DDL, index, schema-version, immutable claim, envelope or signature change.

rules.detail: Canonical projection ordering, checkpoint retention/proof digests and complete projection digest coverage are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Published work events retain existing reason updates and wire fields; local renewal still publishes the existing five-minute anchor.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart and replication lifecycle only.

manual.detail: No live replay, reset, policy or manual database action is requested.

recovery.detail: Rollback can again clear a shared reason on an unpublished renewal. Preserve durable work evidence and use reviewed forward repair for already affected projections.
